subject: V2 content passes; finalize stable Git-byte bindings in three-step sequence
body: Independent review of head 7ee1ef096e9ab03dadddbc279c149bef12aa9a1c: order-manifest CONTENT passes exactly (train SHA matches, row_indices 0..159 exact, all 160 record_ids exact, newline+final-LF digest recomputes 904ac73c...). Remaining blockers are committed-byte binding stability and the initial-digest prerequisite. Current committed SHAs at 7ee1ef0: order manifest e19c3ae0ead38c4527aedb9c5ae4ae481ea6bd320b21bf2e876c23dfc51098a4; stage1 spec 4f669d57c42db32f0aabb9d96264fd71fd6015aedd7c5ae51c32d54667881acc; continuous20 spec c3f95eccf34bdc0bd100899767c66c43c96001544a421edf59f8387c4ccf69bd; eval panel file 8e5ae8eebf68a2687b9905dc99632d11aeaeb74fad328b38f472db9afe483699; protocol 1b3b7c42314436443d958961f8f7fd09d35edc9a915922dca68f977f120d03fd. However specs/protocol still bind stale pre-commit order-manifest SHA b65b..., and protocol lacks committed spec SHA bindings + eval-panel file SHA + initial-trainable-digest requirement. Do this in stable order: STEP1 modify order manifest only to add explicit serialization="NEWLINE_UTF8_FINAL_LF" (or equivalent exact field), commit/push/readback, compute its committed-byte SHA. STEP2 update stage1 + continuous specs to bind THAT committed manifest SHA, commit/push/readback, compute committed-byte SHAs of both specs. STEP3 update protocol only to bind: final manifest committed SHA, final stage1 committed SHA, final continuous spec committed SHA, eval panel committed file SHA 8e5ae8..., existing eval record-id SHA 6a6e..., and prospective invariant initial_trainable_digest_exact_match_required=true using each run receipt weight_digest_before before accepting comparison. Commit/push/readback protocol. Tests must recompute all raw committed file hashes and order from frozen JSONL; report final remote hashes only after readback. No design/gate/row/runtime changes. GPU remains unauthorized until final hostile read passes.
